worldcombat.skill.hardpress.summary: Raise an arm or claw and press the foe into the ground with a short palm face in front: attack and weight set the force, and the more HP the target still has, the heavier the press - a wounded target takes far less. It is the fastest and cheapest of the three pressing moves, meant to be laid down again and again; the two-arm form widens the palm face to cover several foes standing side by side but hits each one lighter, with the same tempo.
Each crushed target takes about %1$s Steel contact damage; the more HP that target still has, the heavier the press on it.

A short palm face is laid out in front: %1$s blocks long along the aim and %2$s blocks half-wide to each side; every enemy inside it is hit once. A hit sinks it %3$s blocks into the ground and shoves it %4$s blocks away from the palm centre.
You can reach up to %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.brace.on: Two-arm form: both arms/pincers press down at once - the palm half-width is x1.7, covering several foes standing side by side; in exchange the single-target power is x0.86, with the same wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.brace.off: One-arm form (default): a focused press, heavier on a single target and narrower, holding only what stands in front of it.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.timing: Wind-up %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cost %3$s PP, cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.growth.0: From level %1$s: press power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.growth.1: From level %1$s: press power rises to %2$s and the press radius widens to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.use.0: Open a fight with the heaviest press on a full-HP target
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.use.1: Pin several clustered foes with the two-arm form
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.use.2: Keep pressing with the fastest cycle of the three
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.preference.b: On: both arms/pincers press at once, palm half-width x1.7, covering several foes standing side by side, but single-target power x0.86 with the same wind-up and cooldown. Off: one-arm form, heavier on one target and narrower.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in before pressing. Larger values press from further out and get walked away from during the raise more often.
On: sort targets by remaining HP fraction, full-HP foes first (the press is heaviest on them). Off: only the threat itself counts, so it will press wounded foes too.
world_combat.move.hardpress.text.miss: Hard Press found nothing to press
